notes: Portable backpack "bonded cellular" video encoder, not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted). Specs taken from LiveU's official LU600 HEVC datasheet PDF, cross-checked against the official 104-page "LiveU LU600 User Guide" v7.5.3 (uploads-ssl.webflow.com/.../liveu-lu600-user-guide-v75x--7may2019.pdf) for port photos/labels (DC IN, HDMI IN/OUT, SDI IN, USB port, 2x RJ-45). Ports listed reflect the BASE configuration, which ships with the HEVC-HD video interface card (3G/HD/SD-SDI + HDMI 1.4 input, Micro HDMI output). Two optional video-card variants exist and change the video I/O: "4K-HDMI" card upgrades the HDMI input to HDMI 2.0 (adds 4K support, same SDI-in spec); "4K-SDI" card instead exposes FOUR BNC/SDI inputs (labeled 1-3G/12G, 2-3G, 3-3G, 4-3G, supporting up to 4x3G-SDI or a single 12G-SDI feed) and has NO HDMI input at all. An optional "LU600-SMA" hardware variant adds external SMA antenna connectors for the cellular modules (not present on the base unit, so not listed as a port here). A Micro SD card slot (internal 16GB + user-installable card, used for Store & Forward and local file transfer) exists on the unit but is omitted from the port list since removable-storage slots aren't a signal/power connector type in this schema. No link-speed/version is stated anywhere for the two Ethernet ports, the Type-A USB port, or the Micro HDMI output, so grade was omitted on those (only SDI IN and HDMI IN have a stated version). Confidence is medium rather than high because of two open items: the exact physical form of the "Audio jack (in + out)" (single combo jack vs. two separate 3.5mm jacks) and the undocumented "mini USB" interface listed only in the marketing datasheet.

ports.name: HDMI OUT
ports.note: Micro HDMI jack on the video card, used for Video Return / external monitor output; HDMI version not specified by the manufacturer for this port.

ports.name: Audio In
ports.note: Datasheet lists 'Audio jack (in + out)' as a single interface line; represented as two 3.5mm TRS jacks since exact combo/split jack configuration could not be confirmed from a labeled photo.

ports.name: Audio Out (Headphone/IFB)
ports.note: Headphone jack on the video card; used to monitor IFB or Video Return audio (user guide 'IFB Headphone Detection & Control').

ports.name: DC IN
ports.note: Powers the unit and charges the battery. Bundled 90W/16V AC-DC adapter (100-240VAC input) or an optional 12VDC vehicle-lighter adapter both feed this same jack; neither the adapter's AC inlet nor the vehicle plug is a separate connector on the LU600 itself.

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Single Type-A port located above the DC IN connector; shared/reused for an optional 9th cellular modem, USB flash-drive file transfer, and connecting the wired remote control.

ports.name: Mini USB
ports.note: Listed in LiveU's official datasheet interfaces row ('Type-A USB, mini USB, ...'), but the connector-id list has no mini-USB option so usb-micro is used as the closest match. Its physical location/purpose is not documented anywhere in the 104-page LU600 User Guide, which only shows a single Type-A USB port for all USB functions — low-confidence placeholder.
